properties.Description: MAP schema for Themes as complete, typed value assignments for one Meta Design System. Theme availability is independent of Dancer identity.

A user-selectable, complete realization of one MetaDesignSystem's DesignToken vocabulary. It assigns concrete typed presentation values through ThemeTokenAssignments for every DesignToken the MetaDesignSystem defines, allowing a runtime to project the Theme once to CSS. Theme selection is person- and space-driven, independent of Dancer or application choice. The notion of a theme and token-value assignment is common design-system practice, but Theme and its relationship semantics are MAP-native rather than DTCG-standardized.

A MAP-native intersection holon binding one Theme to one DesignToken and the concrete presentation value supplied for it. The ordered (Theme, DesignToken) pair is its semantic key, making one assignment per token explicit and validating complete Theme coverage. Its value is constrained by a DTCG-aligned DesignTokenType, but this holon and its graph representation do not imply DTCG serialization.

A MAP-specific key-rule strategy for intersection holons whose semantic identity is an ordered pair of relationship targets. It gives such a holon a stable derived identity without requiring an independently authored identifier. It has no DTCG counterpart.
Stable semantic name of a Theme.
String-backed value supplied by a ThemeTokenAssignment. It must conform to the assigned DesignToken's DesignTokenType.
Records the one MetaDesignSystem whose complete DesignToken contract a Theme realizes.
Defines what Design Tokens implementers of this Theme need to assign values for.
Inverse of HasThemeTokenAssignment. Each assignment belongs to exactly one Theme.
Identifies the DesignToken whose value is supplied by one ThemeTokenAssignment.

properties.Description: Associates a Theme with a HolonSpace that offers it for user selection without binding the Theme to any Dancer.

properties.ValidationRuleDescription: A Theme may have exactly one ThemeTokenAssignment for each DesignToken.
A ThemeTokenAssignment PresentationValue must conform to its DesignToken's DesignTokenType.
A Theme must assign exactly one value to every DesignToken defined by its ForMetaDesignSystem target.

properties.ThemeDescription: A demonstration theme for exploring DAHN features. Deep Ocean is calm, orderly, and utilitarian, with limited visual differentiation between kinds of controls. Layered navy surfaces, muted teal actions, seafoam focus accents, softly rounded corners, and system sans-serif typography provide a consistent setting for feature demonstrations rather than an optimized human experience.

properties.Description: Human-readable purpose and visual character of a Theme.

properties.ThemeDescription: A warm, handcrafted demonstration theme for DAHN. Walnut canvas surfaces frame warm umber panels and pale parchment collections, with caramel collection headers, dark cocoa table headers, and chestnut action controls. Beige text and amber focus accents complement the browns. Legible handwritten-style system fonts, generous line spacing, and restrained but distinct borders support comfortable reading. Beige collection tabs and relationship rail buttons, muted taupe view controls, and chestnut holon actions distinguish navigation from operations.
